ideas.title: Investigating the Trump Administration's Funding Freezes
ideas.description: This story would investigate the Trump administration's use of funding freezes to influence policy, including the Gateway tunnel project and child care programs in Democratic states
questions: What is the extent of the Trump administration's use of funding freezes?
How have these funding freezes impacted various programs and projects?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to reveal a pattern of abuse of executive power by the Trump administration, which could have significant implications for the use of funding freezes in the future.
